Education

Education that connects
knowledge and practice.

Develop skills in genomic data analysis, variant interpretation and Gennext workflows. Our training brings scientific context and practical evaluation together.

WHO IT’S FOR

For the people
behind the analysis.

Healthcare professionals, laboratory teams and researchers working with genomic data. We discuss your team’s background and objectives to define the training scope.

TRAINING SCOPE

What your team
can put into practice.

Germline variants

Inherited conditions and rare diseases

  • Evaluate variants alongside phenotypes and family information.
  • Review evidence and approaches to variant prioritisation.

Somatic variants

Oncology and molecular pathology

  • Filter and assess genomic findings in tumour data.
  • Review supporting evidence and prepare findings for reporting.

Gennext workflows

From analysis to reporting

  • Navigate the platform and review analysis outputs.
  • Use filtering, evaluation and reporting tools in a connected workflow.
